result.summary: The home screen has several layout/overflow problems: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped, a restaurant name is truncated, and the last popular card is cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The last category chip on the right is cut off by the screen edge, so users cannot see the full label or that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding and a visible peek of the next chip, or a fade/scroll indicator so the horizontal category list is clearly scrollable.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped on the right and the restaurant name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Give the last visible card enough peek/padding, allow wrapping or a slightly smaller type size, and ensure names are not cut mid-word.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding so the last card can scroll fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: Promo banner text sits over decorative circles with uneven contrast, especially the smaller subtitle.
issues.suggestion: Increase overlay contrast or keep key text on a solid area so the offer and code stay easy to read.

issues.description: The notifications bell with a red badge has no visible count or label in the screenshot.
issues.suggestion: Expose an accessible name and badge count so the alert is understandable to all users.
